item.title: Cowan: Jakub Dobes's competitive fire impresses Canadiens teammates

item.title: 'We feel abandoned': 25 UQAM profs in limbo after Quebec axes immigration program
item.description: "I solve problems every day — but I don’t know if there is a solution for this one for my family," said one professor.

item.title: Private doctors' group seeks to invalidate law requiring new physicians to stay in public system
item.description: Bill 83 requires new doctors to stay in the public system for at least five years or risk fines of up to $200,000.
